NewsArticle.Title: The Pact: Death of a Councilor
NewsArticle.Content: Cyril, Councilor of Loures, who has addressed ["The Entreaty"](http://www.darkages.com/2000/news/990921.html) and ["The Sacrifice"](http://www.darkages.com/2000/news/990924.html) died. All of Loures Castle knew of his death by the scream of a servant woman. His corpse was found in his room, mutilated almost beyond recognition. His servant, Paulin, still stands guard by his daughter's room, and sadly remembers his master, our councilor, Cyril. The servant seems unnerved by the death so near his daily station, in the normally quiet hall of the second floor of Loures Castle. His daughter, Jacqueline is as sick as ever. Members of Loures pray that Aislings will be able to go to Mehadi and find her cure. (( Tulsi blooms 99.10.29 through 99.10.31 ))
